title: An organization revokes a credential it issued into its context on one machine, credential-revocation/1 (DEC-0111)
description: Carried in a check-in response's records.credentialRevocations, signed like a policy layer by a key of the organization's current policy key set (policySigningInput). The node deletes the value, and keeps its mark as revoked, when credentialRevocationStands accepts it and the credential it holds answers requestId (DEC-0113); the issuer revokes the credential at its provider as well. docs/specification/credentials.md#revocation.

slot.description: the credential's slot name, never its value

requestId.description: DEC-0113: the credential-request/1 whose credential this revokes; a node deletes the value only when the credential it holds in the slot answers this request, so a late revocation never deletes a reissue

value.description: 64 bytes, base64: an Ed25519 signature, or an ES256 signature as R ‖ S.
